newsitem.title: UK: BA shares up on robust Galileo IPO.
newsitem.headline: BA shares up on robust Galileo IPO.

text.p: Shares in British Airways Plc jumped by more than two percent on Monday after a strong initial public offering on Friday for Galileo International Inc, dealers said.
BA is one of 11 North American and European airlines that is a shareholder in the the global computer reservation company.
By 1144 GMT, BA shares were up 15p at 645-1/2p, against a generally flat UK stock market and above its five-month low of 607-3/8 hit last week.

Shares in Galileo closed in New York at 26-1/8, a premium over its IPO price of $24.50. Signalling the strong demand, underwriters raised the price talk for the deal late on Thursday to $23 to $25 a share from the $20 to $23 indicated in the filing.
BA shares were also recovering from last week's selloff when analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell cut the stock to "neutral" from "overweight" and advised investors to switch out of the stock.
Shares in BAA Plc slipped 2-1/2p to 577-1/2p, Eurotunnel traded 1p lower at 68-1/2p and Railtrack Plc rose 1-1/2p to 777-1/2p.
